exposure: transverse diameter of the pelvic inlet (TD)
anteroposterior diameter of the pelvic inlet (APD)
outcome: success of trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: 96 pregnant women who underwent TOLAC between 2010 and 2021
finding: Pelvic size and morphological findings, as determined by X-ray pelvimetry, have no discernible impact on the outcomes of TOLAC.
